# EntreSkill Hub

> EntreSkill Hub is a production-grade web application designed to help micro-entrepreneurs build their businesses through structured roadmaps, curated learning resources, business idea tools, and mentor connections.

## App Info

- URL: https://entreskill-hub.vercel.app
- Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router)
- Language: TypeScript
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4

## Pages

- [Home](/) — Landing page with feature overview and social proof
- [Dashboard](/dashboard) — User's personalized learning and progress dashboard
- [Roadmaps](/roadmaps) — Business skill-building roadmaps
- [Ideas](/ideas) — Business idea generation and scoring tool
- [Learning Hub](/learning-hub) — Curated resources for entrepreneurs
- [Mentors](/mentors) — Find and connect with expert mentors
- [Assessment](/assessment) — Skills assessment and recommendation engine
- [Bookmarks](/bookmarks) — Saved resources and ideas
- [Notifications](/notifications) — In-app activity feed
- [Profile](/profile) — User profile and settings
- [Settings](/settings) — App and account preferences

## API

- `GET /api/profile/me` — Fetch current user profile
- `GET /api/recommendations` — Personalized content recommendations
- `GET /api/roadmaps/[id]` — Fetch a specific roadmap
- `GET /api/resources` — List all learning resources
- `GET /api/mentors` — List available mentors
- `POST /api/auth/register` — Register a new user
- `POST /api/assessment` — Submit skills assessment

## Notes

- Requires authentication for dashboard, profile, and protected routes
- MongoDB is used for persistent data storage
- Next.js middleware handles auth routing and redirects
